title: Haryana Districts, Divisions and Administration: Quiz

questions.question: As of the December 2025 notification, how many districts does Haryana have?
questions.rationale: Hansi was notified as the 23rd district in December 2025. Charkhi Dadri (2016) had been the 22nd, which is why older books give 22.

questions.question: Which district was created in December 2016 as the 22nd district of Haryana?
questions.rationale: Charkhi Dadri was carved out of Bhiwani on 1 December 2016. Palwal dates from 2008 and Jhajjar from 1997.

questions.question: How many administrative divisions does Haryana have?
questions.rationale: The six divisions are Ambala, Faridabad, Gurugram, Hisar, Karnal and Rohtak.

questions.question: Which district is NOT part of the Karnal division?
questions.rationale: Sonipat belongs to the Rohtak division. Karnal division has Karnal, Kaithal and Panipat.

questions.question: What is the headquarters of Mahendragarh district?
questions.rationale: Narnaul is the headquarters of Mahendragarh district. This is the one district whose HQ name differs from the district name.

questions.question: How many seats does Haryana have in the Vidhan Sabha?
questions.rationale: The Haryana Vidhan Sabha has 90 seats, 17 of them reserved for Scheduled Castes. It is a unicameral legislature.

questions.question: Haryana sends how many members to the Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha respectively?
questions.rationale: Haryana has 10 Lok Sabha seats (Ambala and Sirsa reserved) and 5 Rajya Sabha seats.

questions.question: Who was the first Chief Minister of Haryana?
questions.rationale: Bhagwat Dayal Sharma became CM on 1 November 1966. Bansi Lal took office in 1968 after a spell of President's Rule.

questions.question: Which Chief Minister held office from March 2005 to October 2014?
questions.rationale: Bhupinder Singh Hooda served two successive terms from March 2005 to October 2014. Chautala's tenure ended in March 2005 and Khattar began in October 2014.

questions.question: Arrange in order of time: I Hukam Singh, II Devi Lal (first term), III Bansi Lal (first term), IV Bhajan Lal (first term)
questions.rationale: Bansi Lal (1968), Devi Lal (1977), Bhajan Lal (1979) and Hukam Singh (July 1990 to March 1991).

questions.question: Under which Act is the three-tier Panchayati Raj system in Haryana governed?
questions.rationale: The Haryana Panchayati Raj Act, 1994 was passed following the 73rd Amendment. The Municipal Act of 1973 governs urban bodies.

questions.question: Which tier of Panchayati Raj in Haryana is at the block level?
questions.rationale: Panchayat Samiti is the block-level body, Gram Panchayat is the village-level body and Zila Parishad is for the district.

questions.question: Which of the following pairs of state symbols is correct for Haryana?
questions.rationale: The blackbuck and black francolin are the state animal and bird. Peepal is the state tree and lotus the flower.

questions.question: Where is the Punjab and Haryana High Court located?
questions.rationale: The common High Court sits at Chandigarh, the shared capital and Union Territory. HPSC and HSSC are at Panchkula.
